items.exampleEn: The king paid a large amount of gold to free the captives.
items.exampleZh: 國王付了大量黃金來救出那些俘虜。

items.exampleEn: This snake strangles small animals before it eats them.
items.exampleZh: 這種蛇會先把小動物勒死再吃掉。

items.exampleEn: History shows that tyranny rarely lasts forever.
items.exampleZh: 歷史顯示，暴政很少能永遠持續下去。

items.exampleEn: The police finally caught the gangster at the airport.
items.exampleZh: 警方終於在機場抓到那名幫派分子。

items.exampleEn: At the meeting, only one dissident voted against the new plan.
items.exampleZh: 會議上只有一位持不同意見者投票反對新計畫。
items.glossZh: 持不同意見者；異議人士

items.exampleEn: Life imprisonment is the most serious punishment in some countries.
items.exampleZh: 在某些國家，無期徒刑是最重的刑罰。

items.exampleEn: The traitor sold the army's secret plans to the enemy.
items.exampleZh: 那個叛徒把軍隊的祕密計畫賣給了敵人。

items.exampleEn: A statesman thinks about the next generation, not the next election.
items.exampleZh: 政治家考慮的是下一代，而不是下一次選舉。

items.sentenceEn: Fans called the player a traitor when he joined their rival team.
items.sentenceZh: 那名球員加入對手球隊時，球迷都罵他是叛徒。

items.audioEn: The museum is showing a short film about a famous statesman at two, four and six o'clock.
items.audioZh: 博物館在兩點、四點和六點播放一部關於某位著名政治家的短片。
items.questionZh: 這部短片是關於什麼人？

items.sentenceEn: Weeds can strangle young plants if you don't remove them.
items.sentenceZh: 如果不除掉雜草，它們會把幼苗擠死。

items.sentenceEn: The old actor was famous for playing gangsters in black suits.
items.sentenceZh: 那位老演員以飾演穿黑西裝的黑幫分子聞名。

items.stemEn: After months as a ____ on the pirate ship, she finally escaped.
items.stemZh: 她在海盜船上當了好幾個月的俘虜後，終於逃了出來。

items.stemEn: The judge gave the thief two years of ____.
items.stemZh: 法官判那名小偷兩年徒刑。

items.passageEn: In our history class, we studied the life of a famous statesman from the nineteenth century. As a young man, he was a dissident who wrote articles against the tyranny of the king. Because of these articles, he spent five years in prison. Some people called him a traitor, but many others saw him as a hero. After the king lost power, he became a respected leader and helped pass new legislation that protected free speech. Our teacher said his story shows how one person's courage can change a country.
items.passageZh: 歷史課上，我們研究了一位十九世紀著名政治家的生平。他年輕時是一位異議人士，寫文章反對國王的暴政。因為這些文章，他坐了五年牢。有些人罵他是叛徒，但更多人把他視為英雄。國王失去權力後，他成為一位受人尊敬的領袖，並協助通過保障言論自由的新法律。老師說，他的故事顯示出一個人的勇氣可以改變一個國家。

questions.questionZh: 國王失去權力後，他做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 高額租金扼殺了許多小商店。
referenceEn: High rents have strangled many small shops.
Many small shops were strangled by high rents.
rubricZh: 要用 strangle 的比喻用法（例如 have strangled、were strangled）
句型例如主動句、被動句等都可以
時態合理即可（例如 have strangled、strangled）

items.instructionZh: 用 traitor 造一個句子，說說故事、電影或球賽中被當成叛徒的人。
referenceEn: In the movie, the hero's best friend turns out to be a traitor.
In my favorite spy story, the traitor is the person nobody suspected.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 traitor（例如 a traitor）
時態配合內容（例如 turns out、called 等）
